title: Change
summary: A field change as text: «Собран → Передан в доставку», the old value quiet, the new one in the text colour and medium weight, no badges and no strikethrough; inline in a sentence, as a list of several fields, or, for a long text, revealed in place as «Было» and «Стало».

template.description: Template variant name for SfBaseElement external templates.

root-class.description: Classes added to the root element the component draws.

root-style.description: Inline style declarations set on the root element the component draws, custom properties included.

before.description: The value as it was, text. Empty reads «пусто»

after.description: The value as it became, text. Empty reads «пусто»

label.description: The field's name («Статус»). Printed before the pair only with show-label; in layout list each change's own label is its term

show-label.description: Print «Статус: » before the pair -- a table cell, a notification; off inside a sentence that already names the field

layout.description: inline: «Собран → Передан в доставку» inside a sentence, the arrow and the new value never break apart; list: a description list, the labels' column and the pairs, stacked under a 24rem container

reveal.description: auto: in layout inline, a value longer than 80 characters is not put in the sentence; «Показать изменения» reveals the two values as blocks («Было», «Стало») in place; none: always the pair

changes.description: The changes of one update, each {label, before, after}, for layout list: a property, the JSON island a server prints, or the changes attribute as JSON (markup). A number is shown as its text; null or empty reads «пусто». In layout inline without before and after, the first change is the pair

forbidden_client_responsibilities: deciding what changed (the host gives before and after)

keyboard: Tab reaches «Показать изменения» when a long value is folded; Enter or Space reveals or hides the values
accessibility.focus: Only the reveal's button takes focus.

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-change wherever a field's change is said: a timeline event, an audit log column, a notification «Статус: Собран → В пути», a confirmation of an edit, a version history.
do_not: Do not draw the values as badges or strike the old one out
Do not put markup in before or after; they are text
Do not use it to ask for a change; sf-confirm-change does that
